name: stage73-vmess-http-transport-dataplane-gate
gate_decision: stage73 admits only the VMess AEAD HTTP transport PUT shared-transport Rust dataplane row: the opt-in smoke validates HTTP PUT tunnel establishment, HTTP 200, VMess AEAD TCP command, target stage73-vmess-http-target.example:443, encrypted payload echo, SO_MARKed TCP underlay, MPTCP status, and benchmark; full HTTP/2 h2 pool, HTTPS/TLS/uTLS, WSS, xHTTP, full VMess shared-transport admission, and default/product switches remain closed

rows.evidence: Stage 65 raw TCP, Stage 66 fixed-target UDP-over-TCP, Stage 67 packet-addr UDP, Stage 68 mux, Stage 69 WebSocket, Stage 70 HTTPUpgrade, Stage 71 gRPC hunk, and Stage 72 Meek polling rows are carried
rows.boundary: carried WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade, gRPC hunk, and Meek polling evidence does not satisfy HTTP transport PUT tunnel behavior
rows.next_action: carry prior rows and add HTTP transport PUT as another partial VMess shared transport evidence row

rows.area: VMess HTTP transport PUT data plane
rows.evidence: Stage 73 sends an HTTP PUT transport request, receives HTTP 200, then carries VMess AEAD TCP request/response bytes on the same Rust TCP stream
rows.boundary: this covers HTTP transport PUT tunnel semantics, but not HTTPS proxy TLS/uTLS, ALPN, HTTP/2 h2 pool, request-body pipe, or h2 route context
rows.next_action: carry HTTP transport PUT as partial shared transport evidence and add full HTTP/H2 lifecycle gate separately

rows.evidence: this gate intentionally uses a local HTTP/1.1 PUT tunnel harness and does not execute TLS/uTLS, HTTP/2 pool lifecycle, ALPN negotiation, request body pipe, or h2 route context
rows.boundary: vmess_http_transport_put_admitted=true does not mean vmess_http_h2_full_admitted=true or vmess_shared_transport_admitted=true
rows.next_action: add full HTTP/H2/TLS-specific gate before admitting full HTTP transport or VMess shared transport

rows.evidence: WSS, xHTTP, full gRPC HTTP/2, full Meek HTTPS, TLS/uTLS, and QUIC/H3 transport rows are not executed by this gate
rows.next_action: add transport-specific gates or keep Go fallback

rows.next_action: continue per-protocol rows and matched Go/Rust daemon benchmark before reopening default switch
